title: Brambleskin rank 100
problem: Its relic check needs a living bearer, so the resurrection never happens.
notes: Fix: H: call with "allow dead" Hook batch R (loader/hooks_R.c, research/hooks_R.json). In-game test: Brambleskin at rank 100 on a creature that is killed: it resurrects with 100% Health and gains 50% Attack/Intelligence/Defense/Speed (once per battle).

release_notes.intended: The first time the bearer is killed, it resurrects with 100% Health and 50% more stats.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the resurrection never happened.
release_notes.fix: Now the bearer resurrects the first time it is killed, with full Health and the stat boost.
